arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The school argued the search was reasonable due to a health risk.
The student argued the search required greater justification under the Fourth Amendment.
Justice Souter questioned the assumption that all drugs pose a health risk.
Justice Scalia asked about prior incidents involving students and medication.
